# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import io, os, json, glob, datetime

pc = os.path.expanduser(r"~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions")
restart_ms = 1763104979000  # 15:22:59 近似基线(用 python 本地化确认)

rows = []
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(pc, "session-*.json")):
    try:
        j = json.load(io.open(f, encoding="utf-8"))
        ident = j["record"]["identity"]
        created_ms = int(ident["createdAt"])
        r = j["record"]["rows"]
        preset = r["agentPreset"]["val"]
        headers = r["contextHeaders"]["val"]["headers"]
        tools = headers[0]["tools"] if headers else []
        toolnames = [t if isinstance(t, str) else t.get("name") for t in tools]
        tt = r["contextBreakdown"]["val"]["breakdown"].get("toolsTokens")
        dt = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created_ms/1000)
        rows.append((created_ms, dt, os.path.basename(f), preset, len(tools), tt, toolnames))
    except Exception as e:
        pass

rows.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
print("重启基线(15:22:59) ms ~", 1763104979000)
print("=== 按创建时间降序 前8 ===")
for created_ms, dt, name, preset, n, tt, names in rows[:8]:
    after = "【重启后】" if dt > datetime.datetime(2026,11,14,15,22,59) else "(重启前)"
    print(f"{dt.strftime('%H:%M:%S')} {after} {name[:22]:24} preset={preset} tools={n} tt={tt}")

print("\n=== 最新(重启后)会话 tools 明细 ===")
for created_ms, dt, name, preset, n, tt, names in rows:

        print(f"会话 {name} preset={preset} tools={n} toolsTokens={tt} created={dt}")

        print("  goal:", [nm for nm in names if nm and ("goal" in nm)])
        print("  session_search:", "session_search" in names)
        print("  orchestrate:", "orchestrate" in names)
        print("  spawn_teammate:", "spawn_teammate" in names)
        print()
        break
